steps.headline: Your mind scans every moment.
steps.body: Most of it goes unnoticed. Emomapp makes it visible and creates your reality trajectory.

steps.headline: Two questions. Ten seconds.
steps.body: How is life treating you right now? How are YOU moving through it? Your answers are coordinates on a map. Check in often — and the map becomes a trail.

steps.headline: Emomapp will track your inner world.
steps.body: After enough check-ins, you will see your unique patterns. Where do you tend to land? What moves you? An AI reads your trail and reflects it back.

steps.headline: Your first report in 5 check-ins.
steps.body: After two weeks of regular check-ins — a detailed analysis of your unique patterns. The more you check in, the clearer the picture.

Building.description: The situation is working with you, and you're actively shaping it. Something is moving forward — you're making, building, steering, creating. Energy is going somewhere and something is responding.
Building.question: What can you set down right now?

Protecting.description: Holding ground, defending something that matters. The situation is pressing in and you're actively meeting it — resisting, confronting, managing. You're in the effort of it.
Protecting.question: What in your life right now doesn't need defending?

Receiving.description: The situation is offering something and you're open to it. Not steering, not resisting — letting in. Something easing or supportive is available right now, and you're in contact with it.
Receiving.question: What helped things fall in your favor?

Enduring.description: Something pressing is happening, and right now you're not steering it — you're moving through it. The situation is pushing in, and your capacity to change it is limited at this moment.
Enduring.question: Who in your life could use something from you right now?

Opening.description: You're ready to act, but the situation isn't fully clear yet. There's energy to move — and uncertainty about what to move toward. You're at a threshold.
Opening.question: If nothing is clear yet, what are you already deciding?

Bracing.description: Something is pressing in — or might be. You're on alert, preparing, tensed for what may come. The threat is real or possible; you're not moving yet, but you're ready.
Bracing.question: Are you preparing to act — or preparing to keep preparing?

Seeking.description: Something is available — easing, supporting, offering — and you're reaching toward it. Not quite there yet. Moving toward what may already be starting to come toward you.
Seeking.question: What if what you're looking for has been here all along?

Drifting.description: The situation is unclear and you're not pushing against it. Not passive — more like suspended. Waiting for something to resolve or reveal itself.
Drifting.question: Where does this current take you if you don't choose?

Still.description: Neither pressing nor giving. Neither acting nor yielding. A pause — space without clear pull in any direction.
Still.question: Is this stillness helping you find yourself — or helping you hide?

under5.headline: Good.
under5.subtext: Come back when something shifts. Each check-in adds a point to your map — you need 5 to see your first patterns.

midRange.headline: Logged.
midRange.subtext: Come back when something shifts. The more moments you capture, the clearer the picture becomes. Your full report unlocks at 20 check-ins.

full.headline: Logged.
full.subtext: Every check-in makes your self-portrait sharper. The pattern keeps forming.

Notifications.body:
People who notice meaningful patterns check in whenever something shifts — a conversation, a change of mood, a moment worth remembering.



Turn on reminders and we'll nudge you to check in.
